trigger.what: Cash Ladder Engine reprojected the 13 weeks after the weekly PO cycle was approved, adding Supplier K’s $88K net-30 to week 7.
The Prime Fall ad invoice for $34K falls in the same week, and Amazon’s biweekly settlement lands the week after rather than during it.
Net cash bottoms at $89K against a $120K buffer — a $31K gap, seven weeks out, with four levers still open.

constraints.label: Payroll
constraints.detail: Biweekly, 26th and 12th. Six runs inside the 13 weeks. Not a lever at any price.

constraints.label: Rent, insurance and software
constraints.detail: Fixed monthly on the 1st. Predictable to the dollar and unmovable.

constraints.label: Loan servicing
constraints.detail: Existing facility amortisation. Missing one is a covenant event, not a timing choice.

constraints.label: Sales tax remittance
constraints.detail: Oct 20, inside the ladder. Statutory — the date is not ours to pick.

measures.label: Weeks of warning
measures.note: enough for any of the four levers
